title.purpose: Identifies the Home surface beneath the native Odoo navbar.

headline.purpose: Names a routing card or customization group.

body.purpose: Carries actions, row titles, descriptions, and configuration copy.

label.purpose: Carries timing, pipeline state, and compact operational metadata.

signal.purpose: Keeps task-summary counts scannable without giving them dashboard-KPI prominence.

alertCount.purpose: Keeps exception counts legible inside the dense five-destination accounting row.

clearStateIcon.purpose: Sizes the decorative success icon above concise empty-state text.

motion.name: border-feedback
motion.purpose: Softens widget boundary feedback without lift or translation.

motion.name: loading-shimmer
motion.purpose: Moves the neutral skeleton gradient while a widget is loading; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Responsive Header Actions
components.description: The native Refresh and Customize controls remain a paired, equal-width action row when the compact header stacks.
components.css: .ds-header-actions { display: flex; gap: .5rem; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-header-actions button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.375rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .375rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: .25rem; font: inherit; } .ds-header-actions svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-header-refresh { background: var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa); color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); } .ds-header-customize { background: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); color: #fff; } .ds-header-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 575.98px) { .ds-header-actions button { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 0; } }

components.name: Widget Card
components.description: The flat, bordered container used for every Home routing group.
components.html:
Activities

What needs you now

Current work appears here.
components.css: .ds-widget { overflow: hidden; color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); background: var(--o-view-background-color, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-widget:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color, #dee2e6) 65%, var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d)); } .ds-widget header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: 1rem 1rem .9rem; } .ds-widget-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: #9a6700; } .ds-widget-icon svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-widget h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-widget p { margin: .2rem 0 0; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); font-size: .875rem; } .ds-widget-body { padding: .75rem 1rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); }

components.name: Attention Row
components.description: A compact direct record route with a semantic marker, truncated context, and fixed trailing timing.
components.css: .ds-attention-row { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 3.5rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: .2rem 1rem; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color, #dee2e6) 72%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-attention-row:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); } .ds-attention-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-attention-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #9a6700 11%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: #9a6700; } .ds-attention-icon svg { width: .9rem; height: .9rem; } .ds-attention-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-attention-copy strong, .ds-attention-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-attention-copy small { margin-top: .15rem; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); } .ds-attention-time { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #9a6700; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Pipeline Status Chip
components.description: A compact text status that keeps review neutral and reinforces blocked or failed states with a danger tint.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: .25rem .5rem; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-danger, #dc3545) 10%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: var(--o-danger, #dc3545); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-chip:not([data-status='blocked']):not([data-status='failed']) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); }

components.name: Favorite Destination
components.description: A dense saved route with destination-kind icon, exact context, and company metadata.
components.css: .ds-favorite { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 3.5rem; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color, #dee2e6) 75%, transparent); background: transparent; color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-favorite:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--o-action, #017e84); } .ds-favorite:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-favorite-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: var(--o-action, #017e84); } .ds-favorite-icon svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-favorite-main { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-favorite strong, .ds-favorite small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-favorite small { margin-top: .15rem; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-favorite b { font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Task Signal Strip
components.description: A compact four-cell workload summary whose active counts use semantic color while inactive values stay neutral.
components.html:
3Overdue
8Due in 7 days
2Waiting
1Changes requested
components.css: .ds-signals { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); border-block: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-signals div { padding: .8rem .65rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); } .ds-signals div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-signals strong, .ds-signals span { display: block; } .ds-signals strong { font-size: 1.2rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-signals span { margin-top: .15rem; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); font-size: .75rem; } .ds-signals [data-active='true'][data-signal='overdue'] strong, .ds-signals [data-active='true'][data-signal='changes'] strong { color: var(--o-danger, #dc3545); } .ds-signals [data-active='true'][data-signal='due'] strong { color: #9a6700; } @media (max-width: 575.98px) { .ds-signals { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-signals div:nth-child(2) { border-right: 0; } .ds-signals div:nth-child(-n+2) { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); } }

components.name: Accounting Alert
components.description: A key-specific semantic icon and bold count route into one accounting or compliance exception set.
components.css: .ds-accounting-alert { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 4.75rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-accounting-alert:hover { border-color: var(--o-action, #017e84); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa) 82%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); } .ds-accounting-alert:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-alert-icon { display: inline-flex; width: 2rem; height: 2rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #9a6700 10%, var(--o-view-background-color, #fff)); color: #9a6700; } .ds-alert-icon svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; } .ds-alert-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-alert-copy strong, .ds-alert-copy small { display: block; } .ds-alert-copy strong { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-alert-copy small { margin-top: .1rem; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); line-height: 1.25; } .ds-accounting-alert b { font-weight: 400; }

components.name: Loading Skeleton
components.description: Three neutral rows reserve widget space while its data loads.
components.css: .ds-loading { display: grid; gap: .65rem; } .ds-loading span { height: 3.25rem; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--o-gray-200, #e9ecef), var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa), var(--o-gray-200, #e9ecef)); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-loading 1.3s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-loading i { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; } @keyframes ds-loading { to { background-position: -200% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-loading span { animation: none; } }

components.name: Customization Panel
components.description: The secondary panel for choosing visible widgets and their order.
components.html:
Your Home

Choose what is visible.
components.css: .ds-customize { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(180px, .8fr) minmax(260px, 1.3fr); gap: 1rem 2rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--border-color, #dee2e6); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--o-view-background-color, #fff); color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-customize h2 { margin: 0 0 .25rem; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-customize p { margin: 0; color: var(--o-gray-600, #6c757d); } .ds-customize label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; min-height: 2.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color, #dee2e6) 75%, transparent); } .ds-customize input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 575.98px) { .ds-customize { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

components.name: Add to Home Menu Item
components.description: The native cog-menu command that saves the current destination to Home.
components.css: .ds-add-home { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; padding: .5rem 1rem; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--o-main-text-color, #212529); text-align: left; font: inherit; } .ds-add-home:hover { background: var(--o-gray-100, #f8f9fa); } .ds-add-home:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--o-brand-primary, #714b67) 40%, transparent); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-add-home svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; flex: 0 0 auto; }

narrative.overview:
USL Home is a calm daily operating surface inside the native Odoo 19 shell. It behaves like a well-arranged desk: current obligations are easy to scan, exact working destinations are easy to resume, and human-review or accounting exceptions remain visible without turning Home into a dashboard product.

The surface inherits Odoo and Bootstrap typography, controls, navbar behavior, icon set, semantic variables, and action language. Its own visual contribution is deliberately restrained: a light canvas, content-sized white cards, fine borders, compact operational copy, softly backed metadata and icons, and a small amount of semantic color reserved for state. Customization is available but visually secondary to action and continuation.
keyCharacteristics: Native Odoo shell and control vocabulary.
Activities and My Tasks lead the daily scan.
Flat, bordered cards with compact, content-sized interiors.
Exact destinations and exceptions are presented as dense direct action rows.
Modernized icons clarify widget purpose, destination kind, and exception class without becoming ornament.
Semantic color communicates urgency or completion; it does not decorate.
Customization changes visibility and order without creating a separate dashboard-builder world.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Status colors report urgency, failure, blockage, or completion; neutral surfaces carry everything else.

rules.name: The Theme-Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Use Odoo CSS variables with safe fallbacks so Home follows the active backend theme instead of establishing a competing palette.

rules.name: The No-Hero Rule
rules.body: Home is an Operate surface: its title identifies the place and never expands into a promotional hero.

rules.name: The One-Line Scan Rule
rules.body: Row titles and metadata truncate with ellipses where needed so timing, status, and actions remain visible.

rules.name: The Content-Sized Card Rule
rules.body: Cards follow their content and use `margin-top: auto` only to align a card's own footer; do not manufacture a dashboard-like wall of equal-height panels.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient shadows to Home cards; boundary, tone, and spacing provide the hierarchy.

dos: Do preserve the native Odoo navbar, button variants, dropdowns, icons, typography, and semantic variables.
Do keep Activities, tasks, resumable destinations, human handoffs, and accounting exceptions scannable as direct routes.
Do keep the two-column desktop favorite density, exact destination metadata, and one-column narrow-screen reading order.
Do pair semantic icon and count treatments with textual labels; color is reinforcement, never the only signal.
Do use visible focus, semantic roles, accessible names, keyboard activation, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep errors local to their widget and retain successful content elsewhere on Home.
Do collapse the card grid and signal groups at the shipped responsive breakpoints.
donts: Don't turn Home into an app launcher, analytics dashboard, or alternate navigation shell.
Don't add decorative gradients, promotional hero typography, dense charting, or ornamental status color.
Don't replace Odoo-owned theme tokens, native button variants, or native Font Awesome icons with a custom shell or parallel design system.
Don't use shadow to manufacture hierarchy that the shipped borders, surfaces, and spacing already provide.
Don't expose customization controls during routine use or let customization dominate the first viewport.
Don't hide unavailable, failed, or blocked states without an explanation or next action.
